title: The website editor sheet reads the shared Frequency colours instead of its own drifted copy

source.ref: Child of LIVE-EDITOR-SHELL, the work SCAN-862 folded into it (2026-10-20).

detail:
Split from LIVE-EDITOR-SHELL on 2026-11-16. PREMISE RE-TESTED FIRST, and it was half wrong. A deploy only ever wears the Frequency design, where the editor chrome wears the kit (app/themes/frequency/kit-editor.css and editor-shell.css) and has no .we-shell element, so the drifted token block in components/sites/editor/editor.css never reached the toolbar or the rails. What it did reach, measured in a browser on the real shell and canvas: (1) the canvas frame, where the same block was set on the canvas root, the element the Site renders in, so 33 bare names (--text-body, --dur-fast, --surface-card and others) reached the Site content; --text-body is the app type step, so a text-body paragraph in a Wildheart canvas drew at 19px where the type step is 17px; (2) the few classes the kit has no name for (the Editing banner, the try-it-on bar, the theme controls changed dot), whose colours were undefined outside .we-shell: the banner drew with no background, at 17px instead of 12px, with an invisible dot, in the SITE text colour; (3) the inspector lit row, which read --th-accent and so wore the Site accent (purple on a Wildheart site).

WHAT DRIFTED (old literal, then the shared value the editor root computes by day): text muted #7C766F vs #6E6862; text faint #A59F98 vs #6F6961; success #2F7F5A vs #296E4E; warning #A86A00 vs #895700; danger #C2362B vs #B23227; selection and focus ink #34312E vs #1E1B18; canvas #FAF4EA vs #F4F6F7 (unused, dropped). Equal and now shared: both surfaces, strong and body text, both borders, the pastel gradient and its soft, orb and glow forms, reward, both faces, the three durations and the easing. Dropped as unread: canvas, track, accent soft, live, live soft, reward soft, tip.

WHAT CHANGED. The token block is now aliases of the shared --fq- tokens, pinned on the editor root, so a Site theme cannot restyle the chrome and day and night follow the app. The canvas root declares only we- prefixed names, read the palette ink (--fq-ink, which night does not re-declare) so the ring, tag, toolbar and insert points stay the day ink on the Site surface at night, and each carries a fallback because the frame only has the --fq- values canvas.tsx copies in. Literals in the rules that repeated a token became color-mix over the alias. Two names carry the we- prefix in the chrome because the app owns the bare ones (--text-body, --ease-out). The inspector lit row reads the editor ink. The colour ratchet for the sheet fell from 110 to 8 and the face ratchet from 5 to 0 (scripts/token-baselines.json, re-frozen through the script).

KEPT AS EDITOR-ONLY VALUES (8, each with no shared token of that value): the palette ink and white fallbacks on the canvas root (2), the DAWN stage ground #F1EDE6, the template thumbnail ground #F7F4EF, the pastel glow colour at two other sizes (2) and the Vera orb glow (2).

VERIFIED: the probe fails on origin/main and passes here; the older LIVE-907 probe (site-editor-ds) still passes unedited; a static harness outside the repo ran the real WebsiteEditorShell and WebsiteCanvas in Chromium over the app CSS in the route import order, before and after, on the default and Wildheart themes at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 and at night; the pictures are in the project files under editor/shell-tokens. Measured there: the chrome is the same on both themes, the ring is drawn with the copied tokens removed, the banner and lit row no longer take the Site colours, and the canvas type step is right. NOT VERIFIED: the authenticated route on a deploy, Safari and Firefox (only Chromium is installed here; if a browser does not list custom properties on a computed style the frame gets no --fq- values and the fallbacks draw the ring), real Site content from the block registry (the harness used two stand-in sections), and the modals and Theme tab states.

FOUND, NOT FIXED (outside this row): at night the kit rails and toolbar keep hard-coded light glass (rgba(255,255,255,.72) and .82 in the generated kit-editor.css) under night text, so rail labels are pale on grey; the Wildheart rule in editor.css that lets the DAWN shell wear the Site purple is unreachable under Frequency; the lit row label sits flush on the row edge.

verify.note: Fails on main: the editor sheet holds its own literal colours on .we-shell and the canvas root, sets bare names where the Site renders, and the lit row reads the Site accent. Passes once the editor root resolves every colour role through a shared --fq- token, the canvas root sets only we- names with drawable fallbacks, and every name a rule reads is declared.
